description: The universal pair-equality sentence is true exactly when the carrier is a subsingleton; with a nonempty carrier this means exactly one element.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.allPairEqual_realize.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] : M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.allPairEqual L ↔ Subsingleton M
